authors_reviews.title: High-Capacity 100W Power Bank with Built-In USB-C Cable for Travel. Can charge 3 devices at once.
authors_reviews.text: I'm not really a power user as I am retired and mostly just using power banks for gaming and phones, but my old power banks are not charging fully, so I'm replacing them with this one. It is a practical power solution for my phone, tablet, and even my laptop, so I would order it again and recommend it to others.This portable charger is airline approved at 90Wh, which is a nice feature for travel. The 25,000mAh capacity gives a lot of backup power, and I like that it can charge up to 3 devices at once using the built-in USB-C cable, one USB-C port, and one USB-A port. That makes it especially handy when carrying multiple devices or helping someone else charge too. The fast-charging support is a standout feature, especially for larger devices like laptops, and the LED indicator lights make it easier to keep track of the remaining power. It is also nice not having to remember to bring an extra cable every time because the integrated USB-C cable is already attached. The unit feels solid and well made. It has a sturdy outer shell and enough weight to feel substantial. The built-in cable feels like a practical addition rather than an afterthought, and the ports seem firmly fitted. Since this is a portable battery pack made for frequent use, I appreciate that it includes overcharging protection and real-time temperature monitoring for added safety. It is easy to use right out of the box. You can plug directly into the built-in USB-C cable or use the USB-C and USB-A ports for other devices. Also, you can recharge this battery while charging other items from the battery all at the same time. I like products like this that save time and reduce clutter, and this one does that by combining high capacity with multiple charging options in one unit. It will be useful for travel, long car rides, waiting rooms, power outages, and just keeping my devices topped off during the day.I took a few pictures when I got it to show you what I received: 1- as it arrived, box front; 2- box back; 3- everything out of the box; 4- user manual; 5- top view; 6- back view; 7- power on, LED lit; 8- power button; 9- ports; 10- full length w ruler; 11- case only length w ruler.This is a dependable power bank that is meeting my needs better than anticipated. The price for this item seems reasonable and it would be a welcome gift for travelers, students, remote workers, or anyone who needs dependable backup power. Amazon offers their no hassle 30-day return/refund/replace guarantee with this product and it ships fast and free for Prime members. For the large battery capacity, fast charging support, built-in cable, ability to charge 3 devices, and airline-approved design, I am giving this power bank five stars.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Reviewer

authors_reviews.title: 100W laptop charging in a slim travel-friendly form factor that actually delivers​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
authors_reviews.text: I travel with a MacBook Pro and multiple devices and have gone through a few power banks trying to find one that actually handles laptop charging without being a brick to carry around. The 100W output on this one is what caught my attention, and after using it regularly I can say it earns the recommendation.The form factor is the first thing worth calling out. It is long and slim rather than short and thick, which makes a real difference in how it feels in a bag. It does not disappear into a pocket but it also never feels like dead weight or an awkward bulk. The built-in USB-C cable is genuinely clever because it doubles as a handle when you are plugging it in, and having it integrated means one less thing to forget or lose. The 100W PD output means you can charge it back up fast and push that same 100W out to a connected laptop, which covers MacBooks, iPads, and anything else that charges over USB-C at higher wattages.Laptop charging expectations are worth setting correctly. If you plug in your MacBook Pro hoping for a full top-up you will be disappointed. Realistically you are looking at roughly a quarter charge on a laptop, which is not a knock on this product, it is just physics with 25,000mAh against a large battery. For phones you get several full charges. For me the laptop use case is about getting enough juice to finish a meeting or get through a flight, and for that it is exactly what I need.Things I liked:• 100W output handles MacBooks and iPads, not just phones• Long and slim profile distributes weight well and travels easily• Built-in USB-C cable is practical and the handle feature is a nice touch• Charges back up fast at 100W input• USB-A ports included for lightning cables and legacy devices• Airline approved at under 100WhThings To Consider:• Do not expect to fully charge a laptop, roughly a quarter charge is realistic• It is large, just shaped smartly, not something you will pocket• If you only charge phones there are smaller and cheaper options that might suit you betterFor the price and the versatility this brings across MacBooks, iPads, and phones in one unit, it is hard to beat. This is my go-to travel power bank now.

authors_reviews.title: Amazing quality. The team that developed this power bank is a heavyweight in the power industry.
authors_reviews.text: I've learned over the years when I buy products online, it's always a good idea to look into the brand to see if they are well-known for having quality products with good reviews and ratings. Well, after I did a quick Google search on the Cuktech brand, I was really amazed with what I learned. I found out that although Cuktech is a newer name on Amazon, it’s far from a startup. The power bank was formed by the same core engineering team from ZMI, which was the powerhouse behind Xiaomi's global dominance in the power bank space. Collectively, this team has shipped over 150 million power banks for brands like Xiaomi, LG, and Hitachi. So, needless to say, I was very excited to order this high capacity power bank.When I took the power bank out of the box when it first arrived, I could tell right away that it was a premium-quality product, even before I powered it up. It had a very durable feel, and although it is heavier than standard power banks because of its 25,000 mAh capacity, it still has a sleek design, which I am guessing is probably because of its advanced technology. And although you can't carry it around in your pocket, it really wasn't that heavy, and it was actually much lighter and more portable than my older power bank which had about the same capacity.My favorite feature was the display, which not only shows the battery percentage but also the exact real-time wattage being pulled by each individual device. And when you need to charge the power bank, it also shows the power (wattage) being pulled in as well. And because of this feature, I was able to finally test all my chargers to see which ones are actually fast chargers. So, it was really helpful to know which one of my power adapters will charge the power bank the fastest.And the charging speed of the power bank was amazing, and it is what makes it the best power bank that I have ever owned. It charged my wife's MacBook really fast. Another great feature is the built-in type-c charger which is very convenient since most of my devices are USB-C. And it locks in really good to create a hook, so it makes the power bank easy to carry. And finally, it's under the TSA limit, so you can take it with you in your carry-on.I'm so happy I found and ordered this power bank. It feels very durable and well-built, and its performance and features are awesome. It's a really great value at its current list price, and I highly recommend it.
authors_reviews.author: Mo

authors_reviews.title: Great for those who travel a lot
authors_reviews.text: Quick Facts:CAPACITY: 25,000mAhMAX OUTPUT: 120WPORTS: Built-in USB-C cable (in/out), USB-C port(in/out), USB-A port (out only)I got this portable power bank because I travel a lot and I do not trust public power supplies that run the risk of injecting malicious apps onto your devices. The power supply is heavy enough that you could use it as a club for self-defense, but it is not too heavy, pretty much the weight you would expect. The included USB-C cord is about six inches long and snaps into the top, providing you with a handle, although this is really more of a gimmick in my mind. I do like the fact that it is included, as it is one less cord I have to carry around with me.Charging of my Pixel 10 is very fast, taking about an hour and a quarter to go from 10% to full. I have also used it to charge my laptop and a tablet, and it works great for all of these. The display shows the battery capacity as a percentage. The power button on the side will cycle between that percentage, the draw from any devices that are on it (in watts), and a third press will turn the display off.It supports pass-through charging, and I have had it doing pass-through charging while it was charging both my phone and a Microsoft Surface tablet. In addition to the built-in USB-C cable, which functions as a power supply for your device and for charging the battery itself, it includes a separate USB-C port and a USB-A port. The separate USB-C port can be used to charge the battery; the USB-A port cannot. The value is good.Incidentally, I tried to take a picture with the display on, but for some reason the camera would never capture it.Positives:✅ Very fast charging performance✅ Display shows exact capacity and real-time wattage draw✅ Built-in USB-C cable reduces the number of cords needed during travel✅ Supports simultaneous pass-through charging for multiple devicesNegatives:❎ None noted
authors_reviews.author: Bob R

authors_reviews.title: Huge capacity in compact form factor. Supports pass-thru charging
authors_reviews.text: For the sake of brevity, I will refer to the product: "CUKTECH 25,000mAh Power Bank, 100W Max Portable Charger with Built-in USB-C Cable, Fast Charging External Battery Pack" simply as "bank".This bank has a very sleek and well designed external housing. The housing is made entirely of plastic but the two-tone color makes it look elegant. All the USB ports are located on the right top of the bank. Right below the 3 USB ports is the LCD display which tells you the exact percentage of battery life remaining. There is only 1 button (on the side) which when pressed, will toggle on the display to toggle between percentage battery life and charging rate (in watts).CHARGING: When plugging in this bank for recharging, the display will automatically turn on and stay on throughout the duration of the recharging process so you can keep an eye on what level the battery is at (pic1). A very impressive feature of this bank is the fact that it supports pass-through charging.In other words, you can recharge the bank while the bank is simultaneously charging your phone. The only drawback to pass-thru charging is you lose the ability to see the wattage on the LCD display.DISPLAY: The LCD display is clear and easy to read but it can only display 1 piece of data at a time. You have to toggle between seeing the battery life percentage or the wattage. There's no way to display both. Also, there's no way to display the individual wattage of each USB port. The display only shows the total wattage of all 3 ports combined - When the bank is not also recharging. If the bank is simultaneously recharging then it will not show output or input wattage.I like the build quality of the bank. It is heavy and dense but not very large. The only feature I did not like is the braided flat cable which is not removable. It sticks out from the bank because it can't tuck into the bank's housing nor can the cable retract into the housing.Performance wise, this bank has 2 USB-C ports for input and output and 1 output only USB-A port. Charging speed is not as high as a claims as the 100 watts is the combined theoretical max adding up all 3 ports. Individual charging port is limited by the device plugged into bank and the max output of each port which is disclosed in the manual (pic2).Notwithstanding the high price, I would definitely get this power bank again.
authors_reviews.author: Honest Reviews by Victor L. Goodman

authors_reviews.title: 25,000mAh with 100W output, built-in cable is a great touch
authors_reviews.text: This is one of the most capable power banks I've tested. The 25,000mAh capacity is substantial - enough to fully charge most laptops once and a smartphone multiple times over. What makes it stand out beyond capacity is the 100W max output, which means it can actually charge laptops at full speed rather than the slow trickle you get from lower-wattage banks.The built-in USB-C cable is a genuinely useful feature. There's nothing more frustrating than having a power bank but forgetting your cable. The retractable or built-in cable means you're always ready to go. It's the kind of quality-of-life detail that makes this practical rather than just speedy.The device has multiple ports which allow you to charge more than one device simultaneously - useful if you're traveling with a phone and a tablet or laptop at the same time. The power delivery manages intelligently so the highest-draw device gets priority.The unit itself is substantial in size and weight given the large capacity - this is not a pocket power bank. It's a bag power bank, ideal for travel, long commutes, or road trips. The display showing remaining charge percentage is clear and helpful.Charge-in time is also reasonable given the capacity - you can recharge the bank itself via a high-wattage charger fairly quickly. For anyone who needs serious power on the go, especially laptop users, this is the kind of unit worth investing in.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Reviewer

other_countries_reviews.title: Buen rendimiento y muchas funciones
other_countries_reviews.text: Dependiendo del cargador que se utilice, el aparato puede tardar más o menos tiempo en cargarse al 100%.En mi caso, con un cargador tardó unas tres horas y media en completarse la carga, marcando una entrada de 31 W. Probé con otro cargador y marcaba 16 W, lo que indica que la velocidad de carga depende directamente del cargador que se utilice.Permite una potencia de salida de hasta 120 W y puede cargar la batería de un móvil de 5000 mAh hasta cuatro veces aproximadamente.También permite cargar o dar energía a varios dispositivos a la vez. En ese caso, si se está usando para carga, la energía se reparte entre ellos, por lo que el proceso puede tardar algo más en completarse.No es muy pesado, pero tampoco tan ligero como para llevarlo siempre encima.Durante el uso no he notado calentamiento en el aparato, lo cual es un punto a favor.Incluye un cable USB integrado, aunque es bastante corto. Sirve tanto para cargar el propio dispositivo como para alimentar otros aparatos.En cuanto a construcción, la carcasa es de plástico y las esquinas están bien redondeadas, lo que le da un buen acabado y un aspecto bastante cuidado.Tampoco se aprecian tornillos visibles, lo que evita que se pueda abrir o manipular fácilmente.Conclusión: Parece una buena batería de litio que, con un uso adecuado, puede durar bastante tiempo. Cumple bien en cuanto a funciones y rendimiento y, en general, deja buenas sensaciones en el uso diario.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐La batería tiene un indicador digital que muestra el porcentaje de energía restante y también la potencia de entrada y salida (W).Es muy útil para saber a qué velocidad se está cargando con el cargador o cable que empleemos, ya que no todos ofrecen la misma velocidad, y la batería muestra claramente esos parámetros para tenerlo en cuenta.Además, si los números fluctúan y no se mantienen estáticos, es señal de que el cargador o el cable (no el aparato) puede estar defectuoso (ver vídeo).
other_countries_reviews.author: RaafGP3

other_countries_reviews.title: Energia illimitata nello zaino: la power bank definitiva per professionisti e viaggiatori esigenti
other_countries_reviews.text: Dopo aver testato questo power bank per qualche giorno, la prima cosa che colpisce è la sensazione di solidità: è un prodotto chiaramente progettato per durare e gestire carichi importanti senza problemi.La capacità da 25.000 mAh si traduce in un’autonomia concreta, utile soprattutto quando si hanno più dispositivi da gestire durante la giornata. La ricarica fino a 100W fa davvero la differenza: non solo smartphone e tablet, ma anche laptop vengono alimentati in tempi rapidi e con buona stabilità.Molto comodo il cavo USB-C integrato, che evita di portarsi sempre accessori aggiuntivi. Inoltre, il sistema di alloggiamento è ben studiato e permette di trasportarlo in modo pratico senza che il cavo resti penzolante.Il display digitale è chiaro e preciso, utile per monitorare la carica residua senza approssimazioni. Buona anche la gestione della temperatura: durante l’uso non ho notato surriscaldamenti anomali.Va detto che dimensioni e peso non lo rendono il più portatile della categoria, ma è un compromesso comprensibile vista la potenza offerta.In sintesi, è una soluzione affidabile per chi cerca prestazioni elevate e continuità di utilizzo, soprattutto in viaggio o per lavoro fuori casa.
other_countries_reviews.author: mako

other_countries_reviews.title: Powerbank da 100W che fa sul serio, con una sola riserva
other_countries_reviews.text: Ricevuto tramite Amazon Vine. L'ho testato cercando di essere il più obiettivo possibile, e quello che segue riflette esclusivamente la mia esperienza personale.🔎 Uso e prime impressioniL'ho provato in condizioni reali: laptop e smartphone in carica contemporaneamente. Nessun calo di prestazioni degno di nota, la gestione delle porte è efficace e il display digitale è genuinamente utile per sapere esattamente quanta carica rimane. La ricarica della powerbank stessa è rapida. L'unica perplessità riguarda il cavo integrato: sembra robusto, ma essendo non sostituibile, la sua longevità è l'unica variabile su cui mi riservo un giudizio definitivo.✅ Cosa mi è piaciuto100W bidirezionali, si ricarica velocemente e carica dispositivi esigentiDisplay digitale preciso, niente congetture sul livello della batteriaTre porte simultanee, copre tutti i dispositivi in un colpo soloCompatto considerata la capacità❌ Cosa migliorereiIl cavo integrato è il punto su cui tengo l'occhio: se si danneggia nel tempo, non è sostituibile. Per ora regge, ma è l'unica incognita di un prodotto altrimenti molto convincente.📝 Impressione generalePrestazioni solide, funzionalità pensate bene. Il cavo integrato è una comodità, ma anche l'unico elemento che non posso valutare nel lungo periodo.💬 Spero che la mia esperienza possa essere utile a chi sta valutando l'acquisto.
other_countries_reviews.author: Giuseppe

other_countries_reviews.title: CUKTECH 100W 25.000mAh – Potenza reale e ingegneria intelligente
other_countries_reviews.text: Da tecnico elettronico riparatore di 48 anni (RGMods), analizzo sempre i prodotti cercando il punto debole meccanico o circuitale. Qui siamo di fronte a un dispositivo di sostanza.​Analisi Tecnica e ConnettivitàIl power bank dispone di 3 porte totali (uscite/entrate) per una versatilità completa. La particolarità più interessante è il cavo integrato con connettore maschio: è rivestito in materiale intrecciato ad alta resistenza, una scelta che noi riparatori approviamo subito perché previene le rotture tipiche dei cavi in gomma.​La genialità sta nell'alloggiamento: quando il cavo è inserito nella sua sede, crea una curva solida che permette di utilizzare il power bank con un manico o di agganciarlo come un portachiavi rinforzato. È un dettaglio funzionale che denota una progettazione attenta all'ergonomia in mobilità.​Solidità e PerformanceNel complesso, il prodotto è molto robusto. La configurazione 5S1P (5 celle da 5000 mAh) garantisce una gestione della tensione stabile, ideale per alimentare MacBook Pro o smartphone esigenti a 100W senza incertezze. Il display digitale è preciso e i 9 livelli di protezione hardware offrono quella sicurezza che cerco sempre quando maneggio batterie al litio di questa capacità.​Note e ConclusioniPer completezza, segnalo che manca la ricarica wireless. Tuttavia, per chi dà priorità alla velocità di scarica via cavo e alla solidità costruttiva, è un compromesso accettabile.​Un pezzo di ferro (elettronicamente parlando) promosso a pieni voti.
other_countries_reviews.author: RGmods

other_countries_reviews.title: Potente de verdad, incluso para portátil
other_countries_reviews.text: Tipo de producto: Batería externa / Power BankTiempo de uso: Varios díasCómo lo uso: Para cargar móvil y portátil en casa y fueraExperiencia previa con productos similares: Sí, otras baterías externas de alta capacidadEs una batería externa bastante seria, de las que ya entran en otra liga por capacidad y potencia. Desde que la sacas de la caja se nota que es un producto bien construido, con acabados de calidad y ese punto “robusto” que ya te anticipa lo que ofrece.La he probado tanto con el móvil como con el portátil, y en ambos casos cumple muy bien. En el móvil carga sin problema y rápido, pero donde más destaca es con el portátil, que no todas las baterías pueden con eso. Aquí sí que he podido usarla sin problemas reales de potencia.Un detalle muy cómodo es el cable USB-C integrado, que te ahorra llevar extras encima. Además, la potencia es real: en mi caso, cargándola desde una torreta de carga, he visto picos de unos 70W (se puede ver en el vídeo), así que dentro de lo que cabe cumple bastante bien con lo que promete.Eso sí, hay que tener en cuenta dos cosas. La primera, el peso: no es una batería ligera, se nota bastante en mano o en mochila, algo lógico por la capacidad que tiene. Y la segunda, aunque tiene mucha potencia, no siempre vas a estar en el máximo, depende del dispositivo y del cargador que uses.En general, es una batería muy potente y versátil, ideal si necesitas algo más que cargar el móvil y quieres cubrir también portátil u otros dispositivos exigentes.
other_countries_reviews.author: Jose Luis
